description.en: Spinolestes-inspired compact small mammal teaching form with quiet pelage, short grounded limbs and a localized short dorsal protospine patch. Soft tissue, palette, exact spine count and tail proportions are artistic; not a modern hedgehog recolor or exact pelage-histology restoration.
